description.en: The end time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
The query condition. The format is k1:v1;k2:v2.

description.zh:
指标类型

USER_ACTION_PV_COUNT 整体流量规模PV

USER_ACTION_UV_COUNT 整体流量规模UV

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO 流量转化率

USER_ACTION_UV_RATIO 人均流量
description.en:
The metric type. Valid values:

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: Total page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: Total unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: Traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: Per capita traffic.

description.zh:
查询维度，配合metricQuery使用，默认值为USER, 枚举值如下；
 USER 用户维度,
 ITEM  物品维度
description.en: The dimension of the query. This parameter is used with \`metricQuery\`. The default value is \`USER\`. Valid values are \`USER\` (the user dimension) and \`ITEM\` (the item dimension).
The start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
